label: advisor
definition: The role that helps the owner decide the work and then keeps it honest: it grills a goal, plans it into an effort inside the current sprint, briefs the workers, reviews each sub-issue against its Spec and closes the sprint. It writes no code. The kit-advisor skill fills it.
is_not: The captain: the captain executes an approved plan; the advisor helps the owner decide one.
A builder: the advisor writes no code.
kit-plan-next: that skill proposes what to build; the advisor also answers what a word means and which skill to call.
